title: Commercial Natural Gas Supply Billing Corrections and the Correction Lookback
content:
## Clauses in force

**C1 — Rebill credit.** When a Commercial Natural Gas Supply line was billed at more than the policy allows, the over-billed amount is returned as one rebill credit tied to that line through its source bill line reference. A corrected energy, swing or fee line also corrects the cycle's sales tax line with its own rebill credit.

**C2 — Correction lookback.** A commercial gas line may be corrected only when the business disputes it no later than the plan's correction lookback, in calendar months, after the line was posted. The lookback ends on the same day of the month that many months after the posted date, or on the last day of that month when that day does not exist. A dispute on the last day of the lookback is inside it. The posted date is read from the bill line itself.

**C3 — One correction per line.** Each billed commercial gas line may be corrected only once, as the bill lines show by a rebill credit already referencing it.

**C4 — Agent limit.** A care agent may post a rebill credit up to the agent adjustment limit per line; a larger correction is opened as a commercial gas billing dispute for review instead of being posted.

**C5 — Under-billing.** Under-billing caused by a Beacon Ridge error is not back-billed.

## Withdrawn wording

The wording in C1 that the rebill credit is "equal to the billed amount minus the correctly computed amount and posted as a negative amount" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis and may not be applied.

## Lookback boundary dates (hypothetical lines, with the 12-month lookback of the plan schedule)

| Posted date | Lookback ends | Dispute on | Inside the lookback? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2024-08-31 | 2025-08-31 | 2025-08-31 | Yes |
| 2024-08-31 | 2025-08-31 | 2025-09-01 | No |
| 2024-02-29 | 2025-02-28 (no 29th) | 2025-02-28 | Yes |
| 2024-02-29 | 2025-02-28 (no 29th) | 2025-03-01 | No |

## Agent limit judgement (hypothetical, with the $250.00 limit of the plan schedule)

| Correction computed for one line | Outcome |
|---|---|
| $180.00 | Posted by the care agent as a rebill credit |
| $250.00 | Posted by the care agent as a rebill credit |
| $250.01 | Opened as a commercial gas billing dispute for review, not posted |

superseded_clauses: equal to the billed amount_usd minus the correctly computed amount and posted as a negative amount
